title: Malicious SHA-256 file hash 7905c4ad4267… (OffSeq Mirage)
description: A malicious file identified by the SHA-256 hash 7905c4ad4267729450a64aee8807b347ba1eb09d35d70afa3b0488ecab2de831 was observed by OffSeq Mirage honeypot sensors on 2026-11-14. The file was detected seven times during attacker activity involving the T1105 technique (Ingress Tool Transfer) from infrastructure located in the Netherlands. This hash corresponds to a specific malicious payload, which could be a dropper, web shell, miner, or post-exploitation tool. Organizations are advised to check this hash against their environments and security tools to detect potential compromise.
